definition.simple: A method of separating lighter and heavier particles by spinning them at very high speeds.
definition.academic: A process which involves the application of the centrifugal force for the sedimentation of heterogeneous mixtures with a centrifuge.

examples: Used in dairies to separate butter from cream.
Used in washing machines to squeeze water out of wet clothes.

common_misconceptions: The heavy particles stay on top. (False: The centrifugal force pushes the denser, heavier particles to the bottom, and lighter particles stay at the top).
ai_context.tutor_hint: Think of a washing machine spinning wet clothes! The water (heavier/denser) gets thrown to the outside.
